decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposal by reason of its position, size and external appearance, would be an intrusive development, out of scale and character with the prevailing pattern of development in the locality, as well as having a serious and adverse effect on the amenities enjoyed by occupants of neighbouring properties by an increase level of overlooking, loss of privacy and unacceptable use of a rear terrace contrary to Local Plan Polices SC7, CC1, CC2 and the National Planning Policy Framework.
description:
The proposed development consists of the installaton of a new safety railing to the existng terrace, with a
height of 1,100 mm measured from fnished foor level, in order to allow the terrace to be used safely as a
habitable and usable external amenity space.
The proposal is introduced as a safety-compliant measure and does not involve any increase in the footprint
of the building, any extension of the terrace area, or any alteraton to the existng structural layout.
The design of the proposed railing has been carefully considered to ensure that it sits discreetly within the
existng architectural context. Its height and form comply with current safety standards while remaining
visually lightweight, ensuring that it does not detract from the appearance of the host building or the wider
streetscape. The proposal does not result in any material change to the façade, roofine, or overall character
of the building.
Importantly, the proposed railing does not give rise to overlooking, loss of privacy, overshadowing, or loss of
daylight to neighboring propertes. The terrace already exists, and the introducton of the railing does not
increase its level of use beyond what is reasonably expected for a residental terrace, nor does it create
additonal noise or disturbance.
The proposal therefore enables the safe and secure use of the existng terrace, enhancing residental
amenity while preserving the character and appearance of the building and its surroundings. As such, the
development is considered lawful and acceptable, with no adverse impact on neighboring occupiers or the
wider context.
